standard.summary: HydraLoRA 将 LoRA 扩展为 Mixture-of-Experts 结构——多个 LoRA 专家通过路由机制选择性激活，提升容量的同时控制推理开销。
standard.effect: hydralora_num_experts=4 + hydralora_top_k=2 表示 4 个专家每步激活 2 个。有效容量翻倍但推理开销只增加约 50%。
standard.whenToUse: 多概念训练时每个概念可以路由到不同专家。想在不大幅增加推理开销的情况下提升容量时。
standard.avoidWhen: 单概念训练时 MoE 结构收益有限。推理端需要支持 MoE LoRA 加载。

standard_en.summary: HydraLoRA extends LoRA into a Mixture-of-Experts structure -- several LoRA experts activated selectively through a router, raising capacity while keeping inference cost in check.
standard_en.effect: hydralora_num_experts=4 with hydralora_top_k=2 activates 2 of the 4 experts per step. Effective capacity doubles while inference cost rises only about 50%.
standard_en.whenToUse: In multi-concept training, where each concept can route to a different expert, and whenever you want more capacity without a large jump in inference cost.
standard_en.avoidWhen: The MoE structure buys little in single-concept training, and the inference side has to support loading a MoE LoRA.

advanced.principle: 每个 MoE 层有 N 个 LoRA 专家。hydralora_routing='top_k' 选择 top-k 个专家的输出加权求和。hydralora_balance_loss_weight > 0 时添加负载均衡 loss 防止所有输入都路由到同一专家。hydralora_sparse_top_k=True 时只计算被选中的专家（更快但可能影响梯度）。
advanced.intervention: 替换标准 LoRA 层为 MoE-LoRA 层。forward 时先路由再选择性激活专家。
advanced.expectedImpact: 多概念训练中质量提升约 5-15%。推理时文件大小为 N × 单 LoRA，但只激活 K 个。
advanced.tradeoffs: 需要推理端支持 HydraLoRA 格式。
advanced.codePath: core/lulynx/ → HydraLoRA layer → routing + top-k expert selection

advanced_en.principle: Each MoE layer has N LoRA experts. hydralora_routing='top_k' selects the top-k experts' outputs for a weighted sum. hydralora_balance_loss_weight > 0 adds a load-balancing loss keeping inputs from all routing to one expert. hydralora_sparse_top_k=True computes only selected experts (faster, may affect gradients).
advanced_en.intervention: Replaces standard LoRA layers with MoE-LoRA layers. Forward routes first, then activates experts selectively.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: About 5-15% quality gain in multi-concept training. At inference the file is N × one LoRA in size but only K experts activate.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Requires inference-side support for the HydraLoRA format.
advanced_en.codePath: core/lulynx/ → HydraLoRA layer → routing + top-k expert selection
